Zoe: Hi all, first day here. Building runtime from source in dev container and link fails:

/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lcublasLt
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status

I'm on an A100 dev VM, following docs/BUILDING.md. Any quick fixes?

Ravi: welcome Zoe! -lcublasLt missing usually means CUDA toolkit in the container doesn't match host drivers or you're using a minimal runtime image that omits dev libs. What is your base image and CUDA version?

Zoe: base is `runtime-dev:latest` (we use ubuntu + cuda-toolkit-11.3). Host driver is 525.x per infra-bot.

Anika: CUDA 11.3 might not ship cublasLt as a separate library or the path isn't added. We standardized on 11.8 for A100s. Two options: (1) switch dev image to `nvidia/cuda:11.8-devel-ubuntu22.04` so cublas/cublasLt present, or (2) bind-mount host /usr/local/cuda/lib64 into container for quick test. Prefer (1). Also ensure CMake finds cublas by pointing -DCUDATOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR or setting CUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR env.

Zoe: tried switching to 11.8-devel image and rebuilt. Link error changed to unresolved symbol _cublasLtMatmulDescCreate.

Ravi: unresolved symbol suggests mixing headers/libs from different toolkit versions or building some object files against older headers. Clean the build dir (`rm -rf build && cmake ..`) and rebuild entirely after changing base image. Also check your `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` at runtime.

Zoe: cleaned and rebuilt, link now passes. Tests that invoke cublasLt run but slow; infra-bot says node is A100-SXM4. Any perf tips for local dev?

Anika: for dev perf: enable mixed precision tests only if CUDA/cuBLAS support it; set TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF for caching, and use `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` for deterministic debug runs (but slower). For CI/perf runs we use dedicated nodes with pinned NUMA and cgroups. Add a short note to docs/BUILDING.md about preferred base image (11.8-devel) and clean-build after switching toolkit.

Zoe: added a tiny PR updating dev Dockerfile to 11.8-devel and docs note. Thanks for the fast help :tada:
